purpose: Reduce the M75 candidate budget with sparse selection and a bounded residual.

gate.selection: consensus must beat the fixed reference and approach the per-case best single under case-disjoint evaluation
gate.primary: cost and V_rel paired intervals exclude zero versus the matched reference
gate.guard: legalizer rung/solves and area/b2b/grouping do not regress
gate.budget: K <= 4 trajectories with all projection and legalizer calls counted

claim_boundary: Learned sparse fusion is rejected. The frozen target-free min-B2B policy is retained for a fresh case-disjoint confirmation; no SOTA or external-PPA claim follows from the current 92-case holdout.
